verdict.rationale: Mesh documents a dedicated API endpoint that 'Returns the audit log trail for a case', so the core retrieval is covered. Cases carry explicit human decisions (no risk / risk accepted / offboard). Separately, AI agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and humans can review or override agent decisions, so both decision types exist to be logged. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that audit entries are timestamped and attribute actor type (human vs automated agent), confirmation that agent auto-remediations appear in the case audit trail, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
